display.title: Episode 10: The Ten Wedding Gifts, Chapter 4
display.summary_short: The final chapter of "The Ten Wedding Gifts": the lost boy's father, a poritz, rewards the kind couple, and the Baal Shem Tov's ten promises come true. Plus riddles from the mailbox.
display.summary_long: Uncle Yossi thanks the many families who call and write, and the show opens with a lively march. After the sponsor, a recap: the lost boy that Avraham and Sarah sheltered is the only son of a wealthy poritz who is searching desperately for him. A young club member leads the Shema. In the concluding chapter, the couple bring the boy home safe; Avraham refuses a reward, saying he only did what the Torah teaches, to love your fellow as yourself. The grateful poritz throws a banquet for all the noblemen and gives the couple the town park; another poritz gives the lumberyard, and one after another they present all ten gifts the Baal Shem Tov's students had promised at the wedding. Hashem rewards Torah and mitzvos in full measure, sometimes through tzaddikim as His messengers. The mailbox brings a boy who learned the twelve pesukim booklet by heart, plans for a longer show, and riddles about an arithmetic book, the cake on Noach's ark and why Yosef was so straight.
display.lesson: Hashem rewards kindness in full measure, sometimes sending tzaddikim as His messengers; do good without seeking a reward.
